list.heading: My Games
list.emptyDescription: A Team Admin creates games from the team page.

ready.hint: Press Ready when you are done. The game starts when everyone is ready, or when the preparation ends.

endDialog.title: End this game?
endDialog.description: The game finishes for everyone and moves to the archive. Open reviews close with the votes cast so far, and a review with no votes counts as accepted. This cannot be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this game?
deleteDialog.description: This will permanently delete the game, its team goal, every resolution written for it, its bingo cards and related gameplay data. The team and its other games are not affected. This action cannot be undone.

leaveDialog.title: Leave this game?
leaveDialog.description: Your bingo card, your leaderboard entry, your resolutions for this game and the resolutions written for you in it will be deleted. The resolutions you wrote for other players stay on their cards. You can only rejoin if a Team Admin invites you again. If you are its only Team Admin, promote another player on the team page first.

inviteDialog.title: Invite to Game
inviteDialog.description: Team members who do not play this game. They join it right away and are notified.
inviteDialog.nobody: Every team member already plays this game.
inviteDialog.loadFailed: Failed to load the team members

configDialog.title: Configure Game
configDialog.description: The game ends automatically after its last day. Without a date, it ends only when you end it.

teamGoal.fallbackHint: If none is set before the game starts, a prepared resolution becomes the goal.

progress.title: Progress
progress.notStarted: Progress is shown once bingo starts.
progress.chartLabel: Completed resolutions of each player over time

personalTab.title: Your resolutions
personalTab.description: Write your own resolutions for this game. They fill your card together with the team goal and what your teammates write for you.
personalTab.counterHint: Your card needs {target, plural, one {# resolution} other {# resolutions}} from you. Missing ones are filled with prepared resolutions; if you write more, some are picked at random.
personalTab.empty: You have not written any resolutions for this game yet.

teammatesTab.title: For your teammates
teammatesTab.description: Write one resolution for each teammate. A teammate you write nothing for gets a short prepared resolution instead.
teammatesTab.empty: You are the only player of this game.
